decisions.name: Port of Spain
decisions.reason: The existing first-party-review packet explicitly contains parcel polygons in Port of Spain neighborhoods Woodbrook and St. James. The WUP settlement centroid is shifted by 8.27 km but remains the same city; prior attempt should be skipped.

evidence.observation: Prior country packet documents three closed-ring polygons in the Port of Spain area, specifically Woodbrook and St. James; response was not retained because it included surveyor-name personal data.

Public parcel layer query returned three polygons within a small bounded Port of Spain envelope, with safe request metadata retained and no owner values retained in this packet. Distance to WUP settlement centroid is 8.27 km.
